data.raw_text: BARILI, Cebu — Two customers allegedly tested a firecracker inside a regulated selling zone, triggering a blaze that destroyed nine firecracker stalls at Sitio Estaca, Barangay Minolos in this town. https://t.co/zbWm37g9pl
